name: Sentiments Bloom in a Squire's Garden
source:
"Sentiment's Bloom in a Squire's Garden" is a visual novel that takes on a queer retelling of a frog seeking help from a princess to become human again. Follow the adventure of a royal dealing with the expectations as the heir to the throne and a knight-turned-frog fighting for justice.

[From [url=https://florenstry.itch.io/sentiments-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Sentiment's Bloom in a Squire's Garden》是一部以酷儿视角重新演绎“青蛙向公主求助以变回人类”经典童话的视觉小说。跟随背负王位继承人重望的王室成员，以及化作青蛙仍为正义而战的骑士，一同踏上这场冒险之旅吧。

[摘自[url=https://florenstry.itch.io/sentiments-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
